question: Which active volcano is known as the Light House of the Mediterranean?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stromboli.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stromboli**

 
 
• ​Stromboli is an island in the **Tyrrhenian Sea**, off the north coast of Sicily.
 
• It contains Mount Stromboli, one of the three active volcanoes in Italy.
 
• It is one of the eight Aeolian Islands, a volcanic arc north of Sicily. 
 
• The volcano has erupted many times and is constantly active with minor eruptions.
 
• It gives rise to the island's nickname **"Lighthouse of the Mediterranean".**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cotopaxi**

 
 
• **​**Cotopaxi is an active **stratovolcano** in the Andes Mountains.
 
• It is located in Latacunga city of Cotopaxi Province.
 
• It is the** second highest summit in Ecuador**, reaching a height of **5,897 m.**
 
• Cotopaxi is among the highest active volcanoes in the world.
 
• Its most recent eruption began on 14 August 2015 and ended on 24 January 2016.
 
 
 
• **Mt Etna**
 
 
• **​**Mount Etna is one of the world's most active volcanoes.
 
• Mount Etna has been designated a Decade Volcano by the United Nations.
 
• In June 2013, it was added to the list of **UNESCO World Heritage Sites.**
 
• It is one of the** tallest active volcanoes **in Europe.
 
 
 
• **Mt Vesuvius**
 
 
• **​**Mount Vesuvius is a** somma-stratovolcano.**
 
• It is located on the Gulf of Naples in Campania, Italy.
 
• It is one of several volcanoes which form the Campanian volcanic arc. 
 
 

100:T1
